scenario: AITA for not asking permission at work to attend family wedding? | I've been with the company for over 13 years. Hard worker, never makes a fuss. I know thats not rational because I have bills and family that I can't go without a solid paycheck for too long. My parents think I'm the asshole because I didn't ask permission. My co-worker thinks they are being unfair to me because she was allowed to take two 2 week vacations.
